vulnerabilities.description: paste is unmaintained: archived by its author, no fixed release exists.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Drop the ignore when soroban-sdk stops pulling paste.

analysis.detail: Build-time-only macro crate, pulled transitively by soroban-env-common. It generates trait impls at compile time and contributes no runtime code to the published contract Wasm (cargo tree --target wasm32v1-none -p streampay-contract -e normal contains no paste). Archived upstream, so there is no fixed version to move to. This mirrors the RUSTSEC-2024-0436 entry in deny.toml; the two must stay in step.

vulnerabilities.description: crypto-bigint: timing variability in operations intended to be constant-time.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Drop the ignore when soroban-sdk moves off the RustCrypto 0.13 stack.

analysis.detail: Transitive through soroban-env-host 29.0.1 -> elliptic-curve 0.13.8, which requires crypto-bigint 0.5.x, so the upstream fix (>=0.7.6) cannot be selected while soroban-sdk 29.0.1 is current. Host-side only: the wasm32v1-none dependency graph for streampay-contract contains no crypto-bigint, so it is not linked into the published contract Wasm. Where it does run (env host under tests and simulation) the arithmetic is public-key signature verification, not a secret scalar. This mirrors the RUSTSEC-2026-0387 entry in deny.toml.
